scope: Actual CLI-authority registration of a committed Git source, observed immutable runtime and sealed operator-only artifact; real plan, refusal before approval, approval, apply, durable job, integrity verification, native DRP1 SSH transfer, restricted NixOS gateway, host Datom journal, persistent serving controller, public failure and same-operation recovery. No seeded review or test job/host/probe invoker. Initial job uses owned immutable source argv; recovery uses the packaged CLI.
limitations: Workstation root caller and declared resource/restart integration remain open; no production activation or application runtime selection changed.
Human approval policy and actual engine actions are exercised; the terminal/desktop human approval UI is not qualified.
Traffic coverage is sampled loopback engine HTTP; no full browser/WebSocket, reboot or cross-runtime writer handover claim.
No production database migration or native Messages ingress cutover.
Source-loaded CLI and helper startup remain optimization work; these single-run times are not a performance benchmark.
